results.title: XBOX and McDonald’s Join Forces to Reward Fans of Halo, Forza, Fallout, Overwatch, and More with Exclusive Digital Gifts
results.description: XBOX and McDonald's have announced a collaboration to offer exclusive digital rewards for popular games like Halo, Forza, and Fallout as part of XBOX's 25th anniversary celebrations. The promotion, available in the UK and Ireland, will include themed menus inspired by XBOX franchises, with digital rewards accessible through the McDonald's app. Specific launch details are forthcoming.
